'''Donn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] seen in the restaurant of the [[Sanads of Rorkee]] hotel in [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]]. He was playing the [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]] variant of [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] with fellow Gungan [[Mik]] &mdash; as both of them mistrusted others too much to play with anyone else.
